abstract: This study examines the dynamics of return spillovers in the Lumber, Grain and Soft commodity markets, by adopting the DY 2012 Spillover Framework on the daily frequency data from January 2010 to December 2023. The findings confirm the interconnectedness and spillover effects among various agricultural commodities, quantified by a spillover index value of 20.90%, indicating a notable degree of market interconnectedness. The net spillover analysis shows that Corn Futures emerge as major return spillover transmitters, however, while Oats and Coffee Futures are identified as the primary recipients. Furthermore, the GJR-GARCH model result revealed that Lumber Futures exhibit the highest level of volatility persistence, followed by Sugar Futures, highlighting the presence of asymmetric volatility behaviours. However, Oats and coffee show a negative leverage effect in the market. The DCC-GJR-GARCH model further reveals time-varying correlations among commodity pairs, with persistently high co-movement observed across the sample period. Our research findings contribute to the in-depth understanding of the complex dynamics of the agricultural commodity market and provide significant insights to financial investors and policymakers. KEYWORDS: Commodity market return spillover volatility GJR-GARCH DCC-GJR-GARCH JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q14 Q50
abstract_zh: 本研究采用DY 2012溢出框架，基于2010年1月至2023年12月的日度频率数据，考察了木材、谷物及软性大宗商品市场的收益溢出动态。研究结果证实了各类农产品之间的相互关联性及溢出效应，通过溢出指数值20.90%予以量化，表明市场具有显著的互联程度。净溢出分析显示，玉米期货成为主要的收益溢出传递者，而燕麦和咖啡期货则被识别为主要接收者。此外，GJR-GARCH模型结果表明，木材期货表现出最高水平的波动持续性，其次为糖期货，凸显了非对称波动行为的存在。然而，燕麦和咖啡在市场呈现负杠杆效应。DCC-GJR-GARCH模型进一步揭示了商品对之间时变的相关性，在整个样本期内观察到持续较高的协同运动。本研究结果有助于深入理解农产品市场的复杂动态，并为金融投资者和政策制定者提供重要见解。关键词：商品市场 收益溢出 波动性 GJR-GARCH DCC-GJR-GARCH JEL分类：Q14 Q50
title: Spillover effects and volatility persistence in agricultural commodities: an empirical study of Lumber, Grain and Soft markets
title_zh: 农产品溢出效应与波动持续性：木材、谷物及软性商品市场的实证研究

abstract: Firms’ green technology investments are increasingly important for competitive positioning, yet their impact on long-run performance remains unclear. Using electricity capacity data for global utility firms, we construct a unique structural measure of technological greenness based on renewable versus fossil fuel physical infrastructure. We find that adopting sustainable technologies is followed by a long-run improvement in corporate fundamentals that is only partially reflected in stock prices, yielding superior returns over a multi-year horizon. These results partly reflect higher revenue growth in liberalized retail markets rather than investor sentiment, revealing a consumer-based mechanism that likely extends to competitive downstream sectors.
abstract_zh: 企业绿色技术投资对竞争定位日益重要，但其对长期绩效的影响仍不明确。利用全球公用事业企业的电力产能数据，我们构建了一个基于可再生能源与化石燃料物理基础设施的独特结构性技术绿色度指标。研究发现，采纳可持续技术后，企业基本面在长期内得到改善，而这一改善仅部分反映在股价中，从而在多年期内产生超额回报。这些结果部分反映了自由化零售市场中更高的收入增长，而非投资者情绪，揭示了一种基于消费者的机制，该机制可能延伸至竞争性下游行业。
title: Technological greenness and long-run performance: Evidence from the utility industry
title_zh: 技术绿色度与长期绩效：来自公用事业行业的证据

abstract: This paper evaluates the economic implications of climate change in the Philippines. Data spanning two decades reveal that warmer temperatures increase out-migration, yet locations exposed to intense heat send fewer migrants to historically connected destinations. This pattern raises the question of how climate change affects the spatial allocation of economic activity when mobility is constrained. I employ a quantitative spatial equilibrium model in which rising temperatures and sea-level rise depress local amenities and productivity. Taking climate projections for 2100, I estimate aggregate welfare and output to fall by 15% and 12% respectively, with more prominent losses for high-skilled workers. Large-scale coastal protection can offset damages by up to 3 percentage points, but removing migration barriers attenuates welfare losses by as much as 13 percentage points.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了气候变化对菲律宾的经济影响。跨越二十年的数据显示，气温升高增加了人口外迁，然而遭受酷热地区向历史上联系紧密的目的地输送的移民却较少。这一现象引发了关于在流动性受限时气候变化如何影响经济活动空间布局的问题。我采用了一个定量空间均衡模型，其中气温上升和海平面上升降低了地方宜居性与生产力。依据2100年的气候预测，我估算总体福利和产出将分别下降15%和12%，且高技能工人遭受的损失更为显著。大规模海岸防护措施可抵消高达3个百分点的损害，而消除迁移障碍则能将福利损失减轻多达13个百分点。
title: Economic consequences of climate change: Evidence from the Philippines
title_zh: 气候变化的经济后果：来自菲律宾的证据

abstract: Urban sprawl is a major spatial transformation process characterized by the unplanned expansion of urban areas into surrounding rural and natural landscapes. As a result, rural areas at the urban fringe are increasingly exposed to pressures driven by population growth, housing demand, and expanding transportation infrastructure, giving rise to hybrid “rurban” landscapes. Managing these areas requires not only monitoring land use change but also identifying zones at risk of transformation before irreversible change occurs.Since the 1980s, Antalya has experienced rapid population growth, tourism-driven economic expansion, and largely uncoordinated development, leading to significant changes in surrounding agricultural and rural landscapes. This study develops a Geographic Information System (GIS) and remote sensing–based spatial analysis framework to systematically identify rural areas under urban sprawl pressure. The approach integrates the direction and intensity of urban expansion with existing rural land use patterns to examine their spatial interactions.Using multi-temporal satellite imagery within a GIS environment, the spatio-temporal dynamics of urban growth were analyzed and rural areas with high susceptibility to urban encroachment were delineated. The results show that the impacts of urban sprawl extend beyond existing built-up areas and are increasingly concentrated in transitional rural zones that remain unurbanized yet are critical for planning.The identified spatial patterns provide a basis for an early warning framework to support the protection of agricultural land and the development of preventive land use policies. Although tested in Antalya, the proposed framework is transferable to regions experiencing similar urbanization dynamics.
abstract_zh: 城市蔓延是一种主要的空间转型过程，其特征是城市区域无计划地向周边乡村和自然景观扩张。因此，城市边缘的乡村地区日益面临由人口增长、住房需求和交通基础设施扩展所驱动的压力，催生了城乡融合的“半城市化”景观。管理这些区域不仅需要监测土地利用变化，还需在不可逆变化发生前识别面临转型风险的区域。自20世纪80年代以来，安塔利亚经历了快速的人口增长、旅游业驱动的经济扩张以及大体上缺乏协调的开发活动，导致周边农业和乡村景观发生显著变化。本研究开发了一个基于地理信息系统（GIS）和遥感的空间分析框架，以系统性地识别处于城市蔓延压力下的乡村地区。该方法将城市扩张的方向和强度与现有乡村土地利用模式相结合，考察其空间相互作用。利用GIS环境中的多时相卫星影像，分析了城市增长的空间-时间动态，并划定了对城市侵占高度敏感的乡村区域。结果表明，城市蔓延的影响已超出既有建成区，日益集中于尚未城市化但对规划至关重要的过渡性乡村地带。所识别的空间格局为早期预警框架提供了基础，以支持农业用地保护和预防性土地利用政策的制定。尽管在安塔利亚进行了测试，该框架可推广至经历类似城市化动态的其他地区。
title: Spatial identification of rural areas under urban sprawl pressure: Preventive land-use policy framework for Antalya (Turkey)
title_zh: 城市蔓延压力下乡村地区的空间识别：安塔利亚（土耳其）预防性土地利用政策框架

abstract: We establish normal approximation in the Wasserstein metric for both non-degenerate and degenerate second-order U-statistics under cross-sectional dependence using Stein's method. For the non-degenerate case, our results extend recent studies on the asymptotic properties of sums of cross-sectionally dependent random variables. The degenerate case is more challenging due to the additional dependence induced by the nonlinearity of the U-statistic kernel. Through a specific implementation of Stein's method, we derive convergence rates under conditions on the mixing rate, the sparsity of the cross-sectional dependence structure, and the moments of the U-statistic kernel. Finally, we demonstrate the application of our theoretical results with a nonparametric specification test for data with cross-sectional dependence.
abstract_zh: 我们利用Stein方法，在横截面依赖条件下，针对非退化和退化二阶U统计量，建立了Wasserstein度量下的正态近似。对于非退化情形，我们的结果扩展了近期关于横截面依赖随机变量和渐近性质的研究。退化情形因U统计量核的非线性引入额外依赖性而更具挑战性。通过Stein方法的一种特定实现，我们在混合速率、横截面依赖结构的稀疏性以及U统计量核的矩条件下，推导出收敛速率。最后，我们通过一个针对横截面依赖数据的非参数设定检验，展示了我们理论结果的应用。
title: Normal approximation for U-statistics with cross-sectional dependence
title_zh: 横截面依赖下U统计量的正态逼近

abstract: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax–a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various Census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the Census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade, and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.
abstract_zh: 我们利用自19世纪初起新收集的历史财产税记录，研究美国的财富积累历史与地理分布。这些记录源自一般财产税的管理实践——该税种旨在覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县及国家层面的财富序列。在州级层面，我们依据多来源的州级报告中的年度评估价值。鉴于评估价值可能与市场价值存在差异，我们还需评估比率，即评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（包括“财富、债务与税收”等各类普查报告）中获取州级评估比率，普查中进行了详尽的估值工作，并辅以州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，以构建更高频率的评估比率序列。由此，我们得到了各州从1850年（或更早，视州而定）至1935年的长期年度财富序列。国家财富序列则通过汇总这些州级序列获得。在县级层面，我们利用每十年美国人口普查财富数据中的评估价值（或可得情况下的市场价值），并应用州级或县级评估比率（若可得），以获取1850年至1930年间每十年的市场财富价值。利用这些数据，我们首先展示，美国在内战后至大萧条前经历了非凡的财富积累。其次，自19世纪中叶以来，美国的空间不平等显著且高度持续。我们还探讨了长期财富增长的决定因素，发现，在其他结果中，内战前奴隶财产占比更高或财富不平等更严重的县，其后续长期财富增长较低。
title: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
title_zh: 美国财富与财产税研究

abstract: Land degradation and native vegetation loss in Brazil have persisted despite a comprehensive land use regulatory framework. This study examines how Brazilian federal land use policies changed between 2000 and 2025 and how these changes relate to institutional government change. Drawing on historical institutionalism, qualitative policy analysis, and process tracing, the research analyzes 239 laws and decrees across eight environmental and agricultural policies over eight administrations. The findings show that policy goals persisted across governments, while rules, instruments, budgets, and institutional capacities shifted. Two critical junctures, Dilma Rousseff’s impeachment in 2015 and the start of Bolsonaro’s presidency in 2019, coincided with environmental policy replacement, institutional dismantling, and weakened enforcement. However, prior layering and conversion of environmental policies created resilience, enabling institutional recovery under Lula’s third administration beginning in 2023. Agricultural policies exhibited greater stability, reflecting entrenched economic and political coalitions. Linking policy change processes to vegetation loss data shows that periods of weakened implementation were associated with increased vegetation loss, whereas restored institutional coordination was associated with reduced deforestation. Targeted strategies, especially the Action Plans for the Prevention and Control of Deforestation, were highly effective when supported by institutional capacity. This study calls for greater integration between agricultural and environmental policies, using cross-compliant financial and technical instruments to combat land use change driving vegetation loss, matched with continued whole-territory monitoring and targeted actions across biomes. The findings underscore the critical role of stable interministerial coordination and long-term institutional foundations in sustaining conservation policy amid political volatility.
abstract_zh: 巴西的土地退化与原生植被丧失问题，尽管已有全面的土地利用监管框架，却依然持续存在。本研究考察了2000年至2025年间巴西联邦土地利用政策的变化及其与政府制度更迭的关联。基于历史制度主义、定性政策分析与过程追踪方法，本研究分析了八个行政任期内的八项环境与农业政策所涉及的239项法律和法令。研究发现，政策目标在各届政府间得以延续，而规则、工具、预算及制度能力则发生了变动。两个关键节点——2015年迪尔玛·罗塞夫遭弹劾和2019年博索纳罗总统任期开始——恰逢环境政策被替代、制度被瓦解及执法力度被削弱。然而，先前环境政策的层层叠加与转化形成了制度韧性，使2023年开始的卢拉第三届政府得以实现制度恢复。农业政策则表现出更强的稳定性，反映了根深蒂固的经济与政治联盟。将政策变迁过程与植被丧失数据相关联后发现，执行弱化时期与植被丧失加剧相关，而制度协调恢复则与森林砍伐减少相关。针对性策略，尤其是《预防与控制毁林行动计划》，在制度能力支撑下成效显著。本研究呼吁加强农业政策与环境政策之间的整合，利用交叉合规的金融与技术工具来应对驱动植被丧失的土地利用变化，并辅之以持续的全国范围监测及各生物群落的针对性行动。研究结果凸显了稳定的部际协调和长期制度基础在政治动荡中维持保护政策的关键作用。
title: When governments shift, do policies follow?Tracing policy change in Brazil’s land use regulatory framework
title_zh: 政府更迭，政策是否随之改变？——追踪巴西土地利用监管框架的政策变迁

abstract: After the collapse of Soviet-style planned economies, the liberalization of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) was considered critical for fostering technology adoption and achieving economic development. On the political side, the naïve expectation was that workers would welcome FDI, whereas the current industrial elite would oppose it. In reality, however, workers and managers often formed a powerful bloc against liberalization. This paper develops a formal model to explain why managers and labor unions may form political coalitions during periods of reform and how information asymmetry between managers and workers influences their policy choices. Since managers possess more information about economic conditions, they can sometimes persuade workers to perceive the managers’ preferred policy as the best option for workers’ welfare. If workers believe that managers’ interests are somewhat aligned with theirs and that managers possess a moderate informational advantage, managers can persuade workers that protectionist policies are in their best interest. In contrast, a misalignment of interests or an excessively large informational disparity might lead to excessive liberalization. The logic of this model can help inform policy debates on how domestic politics affect FDI policies.
abstract_zh: 在苏联式计划经济体制崩溃之后，外国直接投资（FDI）的自由化被视为促进技术采纳和实现经济发展的关键。在政治层面，人们曾天真地预期工人会欢迎FDI，而现有的工业精英则会反对。然而，现实中，工人与管理者往往结成强大的联盟反对自由化。本文构建了一个正式模型，用以解释为何在改革时期管理者和工会可能形成政治联盟，以及管理者与工人之间的信息不对称如何影响他们的政策选择。由于管理者掌握更多关于经济状况的信息，他们有时能说服工人相信管理者偏好的政策是对工人福利最有利的选择。如果工人认为管理者的利益与自身利益存在一定的一致性，且管理者拥有适度的信息优势，那么管理者便能说服工人相信保护主义政策符合他们的最佳利益。相反，利益不一致或信息差距过大则可能导致过度自由化。该模型的逻辑有助于为国内政治如何影响FDI政策的政策辩论提供参考。
title: Information asymmetry and cross-class coalitions in economic liberalization: Theory and evidence from post-communist transition
title_zh: 经济自由化中的信息不对称与跨阶级联盟：来自后共产主义转型的理论与证据

abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of forecasting corporate distress, a problem marked by three key statistical hurdles: (i) right censoring, (ii) high-dimensional predictors, and (iii) mixed-frequency data. To overcome these complexities, we introduce a novel high-dimensional censored MIDAS (Mixed Data Sampling) logistic regression. Our approach handles censoring through inverse probability weighting and achieves accurate estimation with numerous mixed-frequency predictors by employing a sparse-group penalty. We establish finite-sample bounds for the estimation error, accounting for censoring, MIDAS approximation error, and heavy tails. For statistical inference, we develop a de-sparsified version of the proposed penalized estimator and establish its asymptotic theory, which enables valid statistical inference in high-dimensional settings with censoring. We show that censoring induces a nonstandard variance structure for the de-sparsified estimator, a feature that, to the best of our knowledge, has not been studied in the existing literature. The superior performance of the method is demonstrated through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we present an extensive application of our methodology to predict the financial distress of Chinese-listed firms and to identify covariates that are statistically significant for predicting distress. Our novel procedure is implemented in the R package Survivalml.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业困境预测这一挑战，该问题面临三个关键统计障碍：（i）右删失，（ii）高维预测变量，以及（iii）混合频率数据。为克服这些复杂性，我们引入了一种新颖的高维删失MIDAS（混合数据采样）逻辑回归模型。我们的方法通过逆概率加权处理删失问题，并利用稀疏组惩罚在众多混合频率预测变量下实现精确估计。我们建立了估计误差的有限样本界，同时考虑了删失、MIDAS近似误差和重尾分布。在统计推断方面，我们开发了所提惩罚估计量的去稀疏化版本，并建立了其渐近理论，从而在高维删失情境下实现有效的统计推断。我们证明，删失会诱导去稀疏化估计量产生非标准方差结构，据我们所知，这一特征在现有文献中尚未被研究。通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法优越的性能。最后，我们对该方法进行了广泛的应用，以预测中国上市公司的财务困境，并识别对预测困境具有统计显著性的协变量。我们的新程序已在R包Survivalml中实现。
china_relevance_reason: 论文应用部分明确使用中国上市公司数据预测财务困境，中国是核心实证研究对象。
title: High-dimensional censored MIDAS logistic regression for corporate survival forecasting
title_zh: 高维删失MIDAS逻辑回归在企业生存预测中的应用

abstract: Cross-border housing markets have become more prevalent in Europe since the establishment of the European Union. Using data from the functional urban area of Luxembourg, we document significant floorspace price discontinuities at the borders of Luxembourg with Belgium, France, and Germany. Employing a quantitative spatial urban model and spatial regression discontinuity techniques, we show that differences in tax rates and tax importation account for 9% and 17% of the observed price jump, respectively. The remaining price discrepancy is explained by differences in productivity and amenities.
abstract_zh: 自欧盟成立以来，跨境住房市场在欧洲日益普遍。利用卢森堡功能性城市区域的数据，我们记录了卢森堡与比利时、法国和德国边界处显著的楼面面积价格不连续性。通过运用定量空间城市模型和空间回归断点技术，我们表明，税率差异和税收输入分别解释了观察到的价格跳升的8%和13%。剩余的价格差异则由生产率和便利设施的差异来解释。
title: Floorspace price discontinuities and taxation in cross-border commuting areas
title_zh: 跨境通勤区域楼面价格不连续性与税收问题

abstract: This paper studies how immigration enforcement shapes participation in safety net programs within mixed-status households. I examine the program participation responses of Hispanic citizens living with individuals facing deportation risk following the enactment of E-Verify mandates, an employment-based immigration enforcement policy targeting undocumented immigrants. Using a difference-in-differences framework, I find that E-Verify mandates reduced household income. Participation responses differ across programs—Medicaid, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), and Supplemental Security Income (SSI). While SSI participation temporarily increased and SNAP participation remained stable, Medicaid participation declined sharply. The decline in Medicaid participation is more pronounced among groups whose household members face higher deportation risk, consistent with chilling effects limiting program take-up.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了移民执法如何影响混合身份家庭中安全网项目的参与情况。我考察了在实施E-Verify强制令（一项针对无证移民的基于就业的移民执法政策）后，与面临遣返风险的个人同住的西班牙裔公民的项目参与反应。利用双重差分框架，我发现E-Verify强制令降低了家庭收入。不同项目的参与反应各异——医疗补助、补充营养援助计划（SNAP）和补充保障收入（SSI）。虽然SSI参与暂时增加且SNAP参与保持稳定，但医疗补助参与急剧下降。医疗补助参与的下降在家庭成员面临更高遣返风险的群体中更为显著，这与寒蝉效应限制项目参与的现象一致。
title: Immigration enforcement and safety net participation in mixed-status households
title_zh: 移民执法与混合身份家庭中的安全网参与

abstract: We study the accuracy of wage expectations among unemployed workers by comparing subjective beliefs to benchmark and realized wages using linked survey-administrative data. On average, jobseekers overestimate their reemployment wages, with optimism concentrated among those with low earnings potential. Beliefs are anchored to past wages, and inaccuracies persist over the course of unemployment and in response to stronger search incentives. Moreover, there is an asymmetry in belief formation: individuals who are likely to experience wage losses relative to their previous job are particularly rigid in adjusting their expectations. Finally, wage optimism predicts higher reservation wages, greater search intensity, and delayed reemployment.
abstract_zh: 我们利用关联的调查-行政数据，通过将主观信念与基准工资及实际实现工资进行比较，研究了失业工人对工资预期的准确性。平均而言，求职者高估了其再就业工资，这种乐观情绪主要集中在潜在收入较低的人群中。信念锚定于过去的工资水平，且这种不准确性在失业期间及面对更强的求职激励时持续存在。此外，信念形成存在不对称性：那些可能相对于先前工作经历工资下降的个体，在调整其预期时尤为僵化。最后，工资乐观情绪预示着更高的保留工资、更强的求职强度以及延迟的再就业。
title: The accuracy of jobseekers’ wage expectations
title_zh: 求职者工资预期的准确性

abstract: Couples can face higher taxes when filing as married rather than unmarried. These marriage penalties may motivate newlyweds to delay reporting their marriage on U.S. tax returns. Linking Minnesota marriage records to federal tax returns, we show that marriage penalties are correlated with delayed marriage reporting. Over 2 % of newlyweds misreport their marital status. Misreporting rates increase to 14 % when marriage penalties reach $8000. Misreporting and large marriage penalties are more prevalent among similar-earning couples and EITC claimants. Misreporting couples’ behavior appears responsive to incentive changes, often correcting their filing status when marriage penalties become bonuses.
abstract_zh: 夫妻在已婚而非未婚状态下申报纳税时，可能面临更高的税负。这种婚姻惩罚可能促使新婚夫妇推迟在美国纳税申报中报告其婚姻状况。通过将明尼苏达州的婚姻记录与联邦纳税申报表相关联，我们发现婚姻惩罚与延迟报告婚姻状况之间存在相关性。超过2%的新婚夫妇虚报其婚姻状态。当婚姻惩罚达到8000美元时，虚报率上升至14%。虚报行为及高额婚姻惩罚在收入相近的夫妇和劳动所得税抵免（EITC）申领者中更为普遍。虚报夫妇的行为似乎对激励变化反应敏感，当婚姻惩罚转为婚姻奖励时，他们往往纠正其申报状态。
title: Do marriage tax penalties cause delayed marriage reporting?
title_zh: 婚姻税收惩罚是否导致延迟婚姻申报？

abstract: Salinity intrusion is an emerging threat in low‑lying regions as climate‑driven fluvial/tidal flooding intensifies. Yet its impacts remain poorly characterised due to focus on biophysical processes and limited understanding of how it affects agricultural productivity, profitability, and risk exposure. The study sought to quantify the impact of flood‑induced salinisation on crop productivity and profitability, assess how it alters risk-return relationships, and evaluate how this affects crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios. The study focused on Greater Lincolnshire, United Kingdom as a case, and used spatially explicit crop, land‑grade, and flood‑risk datasets integrated with enterprise‑level gross‑margin modelling, Monte‑Carlo simulation, and cross‑crop competitiveness analysis. Without flood-induced salinisation, profitability varies across crops, with margins from £ 1114/ha for beet and £ 825/ha for winter wheat to £ 255/ha for potatoes. Under the salinity scenario, all crops incur substantial losses from simulated yield declines. Potatoes show the greatest drop (–£1382/ha), followed by beet (–£442/ha) and cereals such as winter wheat (–£339/ha), spring wheat (–£273/ha), and spring barley (–£304/ha). Risk-return analysis reveals that salinity systematically collapses the profitability hierarchy across crops, compressing them into a uniformly low‑return, moderate‑risk zone and thereby eliminating the high‑value production opportunities that currently underpin regional agricultural competitiveness. Competitiveness shifts markedly, with potatoes most disadvantaged and barley relatively resilient, while portfolio optimisation indicates strong reallocation toward winter wheat. Overall, the scenario suggests that flood‑induced salinisation could become a transformative constraint without flood defences, underscoring the need for proactive mitigation policies, adaptive planning, and investment in salt‑tolerant crop options.
abstract_zh: 盐分入侵是低洼地区因气候驱动的河流/潮汐洪水加剧而出现的新威胁。然而，由于其影响主要聚焦于生物物理过程，且对农业生产力、盈利能力和风险暴露的影响理解有限，这些影响仍未得到充分刻画。本研究旨在量化洪水引发的盐渍化对作物生产力和盈利能力的影响，评估其如何改变风险-回报关系，并考察这对作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合的影响。研究以英国大林肯郡为案例，利用空间显式的作物、土地等级和洪水风险数据集，结合企业层面的毛利润建模、蒙特卡洛模拟和跨作物竞争力分析。在没有洪水引发的盐渍化情况下，不同作物的盈利能力各异，利润从甜菜的1114英镑/公顷和冬小麦的825英镑/公顷到马铃薯的255英镑/公顷不等。在盐渍化情景下，所有作物因模拟的产量下降而遭受重大损失。马铃薯降幅最大（–1382英镑/公顷），其次是甜菜（–442英镑/公顷）和谷物类作物如冬小麦（–339英镑/公顷）、春小麦（–273英镑/公顷）和春大麦（–304英镑/公顷）。风险-回报分析显示，盐渍化系统性地压缩了作物间的盈利层级，将其统一压缩至低回报、中等风险区域，从而消除了当前支撑区域农业竞争力的高价值生产机会。竞争力发生显著变化，马铃薯最受不利影响，而大麦相对具有韧性，同时组合优化表明向冬小麦的强烈重新配置。总体而言，该情景表明，在没有防洪设施的情况下，洪水引发的盐渍化可能成为变革性制约因素，凸显了采取主动缓解政策、适应性规划以及投资耐盐作物选项的必要性。
title: Salinity fundamentally reshapes crop competitiveness and optimal land‑use portfolios in a high-value agricultural landscape
title_zh: 盐度从根本上重塑高价值农业景观中的作物竞争力和最优土地利用组合

abstract: Standard occupational classifications obscure identifying which jobs directly con tribute to decarbonization. Using U.S. online job vacancy data, we develop a trans parent, skill-based approach that identifies low-carbon jobs within occupations, by combining advanced natural language processing with text linked to established green classifications. We show that low-carbon job creation is more prevalent in low-skilled occupations, yet low-carbon jobs systematically require more complex skill sets than comparable generic jobs in the same occupations. These higher skill requirements are associated with a modest wage premium that declines over time and is largely driven by firm fixed effects. Reskilling patterns and low-carbon wage premia vary substantially across occupations, and the latter are markedly smaller than the high-carbon wage premia, especially in STEM occupations. Finally, low carbon jobs are more spatially correlated with high-carbon employment than just renewable energy jobs, but are also more prevalent in wealthier areas.
abstract_zh: 标准职业分类难以明确识别哪些工作直接促进脱碳。利用美国在线职位空缺数据，我们开发了一种透明、基于技能的方法，通过结合先进自然语言处理与既定绿色分类相关文本，识别职业内部的低碳工作。研究表明，低碳岗位创造更多集中于低技能职业，然而低碳工作系统性地要求比同一职业中类似普通岗位更复杂的技能组合。这些更高的技能要求与适度的工资溢价相关，该溢价随时间递减，且主要由企业固定效应驱动。技能重塑模式与低碳工资溢价在不同职业间差异显著，且后者明显小于高碳工资溢价，尤其在STEM职业中。最后，低碳工作与高碳就业的空间相关性高于仅可再生能源岗位，但低碳工作在更富裕地区也更为普遍。
journal: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
title: Emerging skills and wage gaps in the low-carbon transition: evidence from online job vacancy data
title_zh: 低碳转型中的新兴技能与工资差距：来自在线招聘数据的证据

abstract: This paper provides statistical inference for marginal expected shortfall (MES) and delta conditional value-at-risk (ΔCoVaR) measures, which are semiparametrically estimated by a two-step procedure in a multivariate GARCH-type framework. We establish the asymptotic properties of corresponding estimators and illustrate how the estimation uncertainty can be decomposed into dynamic univariate marginal and time-varying dependence components. Our methodology reveals good finite sample performance for estimation and prediction of risk. Moreover, we propose tests for differences in systemic risk in order to construct confidence sets for companies’ ranks in systemic risk rankings. In an empirical application based on 50 large US financial institutions, our framework provides novel evidence on the informativeness of such rankings. Moreover, our findings highlight the importance of accounting for time-varying return dependence in systemic risk estimators.
abstract_zh: 本文针对边际预期缺口（MES）与德尔塔条件风险价值（ΔCoVaR）指标提供了统计推断方法，这些指标在多元GARCH型框架下通过两步程序进行半参数估计。我们确立了相应估计量的渐近性质，并阐述了估计不确定性如何分解为动态单变量边际成分与时变依赖结构成分。我们的方法在风险估计与预测方面展现出良好的有限样本性能。此外，我们提出了系统性风险差异的检验方法，以构建公司系统性风险排名中的置信集。在基于50家美国大型金融机构的实证应用中，我们的框架为这些排名的信息含量提供了新颖证据。同时，我们的发现强调了在系统性风险估计中考虑时变收益依赖性的重要性。
title: Multivariate inference for dynamic systemic risk measures
title_zh: 动态系统性风险测度的多元推断

abstract: This paper develops a procedure for uncovering the common cyclical factors that drive a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables. The method does not require knowing which variables are nonstationary or the nature of the nonstationarity. An application to the FRED-MD macroeconomic dataset demonstrates that the approach offers similar benefits to those of traditional principal component analysis with some added advantages.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种方法，用于揭示驱动平稳与非平稳变量混合体的共同周期因子。该方法无需预先知晓哪些变量是非平稳的，也无需了解非平稳性的具体性质。将此法应用于FRED-MD宏观经济数据集，结果显示，该方法在提供与传统主成分分析相似益处的同时，还具备一些额外优势。
title: Principal component analysis for a mix of stationary and nonstationary variables
title_zh: 平稳与非平稳变量混合的主成分分析

abstract: Predictive regression models are often used to evaluate the predictive capability of economic fundamentals on bond and equity returns. Inferential procedures in these regressions typically employ parameter constancy or piecewise constancy in slope coefficients. Such formulations are prone to misspecification, more especially during periods of disturbance or evolution in prevailing economic and financial conditions, which can lead to size distortion and spurious evidence of predictability. To address these issues the present work proposes a semiparametric predictive regression model with mixed-root regressors and time-varying coefficients that allow for smooth evolution in the generating mechanism over time. For estimation and inference a novel variant of the self-generated instrument approach called sieve-IVX is introduced, giving a robust approach to inference concerning time-varying predictability that is applicable irrespective of the degrees of persistence. Asymptotic theory of the Sieve-IVX approach is based on a new infinite dimensional invariance principle that delivers limit theory for sieve-IVX estimation, validating pointwise and uniform inference procedures for testing predictability and model specification. Simulations show excellent performance characteristics of the resulting tests in finite samples. An empirical exercise is conducted examining excess S&P 500 returns, applying Sieve-IVX regression with pointwise and uniform tests to reveal evidence of time-varying patterns in the predictive capability of commonly used fundamental variables.
abstract_zh: 预测性回归模型常被用于评估经济基本面因素对债券和股票收益的预测能力。在这些回归中，推断程序通常假设斜率系数恒定或分段恒定。这种设定容易产生模型误设，尤其是在经济金融状况动荡或演变的时期，可能导致检验规模失真及虚假的预测性证据。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了一种半参数预测性回归模型，该模型包含混合根回归因子及随时间平滑演变的时变系数。在估计与推断方面，引入了一种新颖的自生成工具变量变体，称为sieve-IVX，为时变预测性的推断提供了稳健方法，且适用于各种持久性程度。Sieve-IVX方法的渐近理论基于一个新的无限维不变原理，该原理为sieve-IVX估计提供了极限理论，验证了点态与均匀推断程序在检验预测性和模型设定方面的有效性。模拟结果显示，所提出的检验在有限样本中具有优异的性能特征。本文还进行了实证分析，考察了标准普尔500指数的超额收益，应用Sieve-IVX回归及点态与均匀检验，揭示了常用基本面变量预测能力中的时变模式证据。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国S&P 500指数及经济基本面变量，数据与制度背景均非中国，作者姓名虽似中文但研究主题明确非中国。
title: Robust inference for time varying predictability: A Sieve-IVX approach
title_zh: 时变可预测性的稳健推断：一种Sieve-IVX方法

abstract: By extracting information from economic news articles, this paper proposes a novel measure of narrative-based ambiguity that captures investors’ attitudes toward narrative uncertainty and exhibits strong in- and out-of-sample predictive power for the stock market returns. It reveals general ambiguity aversion except in high loss probability scenarios in which ambiguity tolerance emerges. Further tests confirm the significant pricing power and distinct information of the narrative ambiguity on top of existing ambiguity measures, such as survey- and return-based ambiguity. By aligning industry-specific narrative ambiguity, we construct a superior predictor for market returns with the predictability predominantly driven by the ambiguity from consumption-, energy-, and technology-related sectors. Our findings also carry broad implications as the predictability remains significant across international markets and other asset classes. This paper has been accepted by Will Cong for the Virtual Special Issue on Digital Finance. Funding: Q. Zhang acknowledges research support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72573098], the National Natural Science Foundation of China Excellent Young Researcher Project [Grant 72222013], and the National Key R&D Program of China [Grant 2023YFA1009200]. X. Wei acknowledges research support from the Capital University of Economics and Business Scientific Research Project [Grant XRZ2025010]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735 .
abstract_zh: 本文通过从经济新闻文章中提取信息，提出了一种基于叙事的新颖不确定性度量方法，该方法捕捉了投资者对叙事不确定性的态度，并对股票市场回报展现出强大的样本内和样本外预测能力。研究揭示了普遍的不确定性规避现象，但在高损失概率情境下则表现出不确定性容忍。进一步测试证实，在现有不确定性度量（如基于调查和基于回报的不确定性）之上，叙事不确定性具有显著的定价能力和独特信息。通过整合行业特定的叙事不确定性，我们构建了一个更优的市场回报预测指标，其预测能力主要由消费、能源和技术相关行业的不确定性驱动。我们的发现还具有广泛意义，因为这种预测能力在国际市场和其他资产类别中依然显著。本文已被Will Cong接受，用于数字金融虚拟特刊。资助：Q. Zhang感谢国家自然科学基金[批准号72573098]、国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目[批准号72222013]及国家重点研发计划[批准号2023YFA1009200]的研究支持。X. Wei感谢首都经济贸易大学科研项目[批准号XRZ2025010]的研究支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.02735获取。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Narrative Ambiguity Matters
title_zh: 叙事模糊性的重要性

abstract: We estimate the effect of education on international migration using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits Mexico’s 1993 compulsory schooling reform, which increased mandatory education from six to nine years. Combining Mexican and U.S. census data, we examine how completing lower secondary education affects migration to the United States during the last major wave of Mexican emigration in the 20th century. We find that completing lower secondary education increases migration to the United States, measured as residence in the United States in 2000, by about 15 percentage points, or roughly five percentage points per additional year of schooling. The effect is larger for men than for women and remains positive across alternative bandwidths and specifications. Moreover, the increase is concentrated in migration associated with work rather than migration associated with school enrollment, consistent with improved labor-market opportunities abroad. The estimates suggest that, where migration corridors are already established, a reform that raises lower secondary completion can also increase international mobility when domestic opportunities are limited.
abstract_zh: 我们利用墨西哥1993年义务教育改革（将强制教育年限从六年延长至九年）作为模糊回归不连续设计的工具，评估教育对国际移民的影响。结合墨西哥与美国的人口普查数据，我们考察了完成初中教育如何影响20世纪最后一次大规模墨西哥移民潮期间向美国的迁移情况。研究发现，完成初中教育使迁往美国（以2000年居住在美国为衡量标准）的概率增加约15个百分点，即每多受一年教育约增加5个百分点。这一效应在男性中更为显著，并在不同带宽和规格设定下保持正向。此外，迁移增加主要集中在与就业相关的迁移，而非与入学相关的迁移，这与海外劳动力市场机会改善相符。估计结果表明，在已有移民通道的地区，当国内机会有限时，提高初中完成率的改革也可能促进国际流动性。
title: The role of education in international migration decisions
title_zh: 教育在国际移民决策中的作用

abstract: Despite major gains in primary school enrollment across low- and middle-income countries, secondary school completion remains low. We conducted a randomized controlled trial in Burkina Faso to evaluate the effectiveness of three interventions designed to reduce early secondary school leaving: (i) information on the economic and health returns to education, (ii) tailored tutoring, and (iii) conditional cash incentives. The cash intervention significantly increased school enrollment, any school attendance, and regular attendance, and reduced the total number of school days missed. Tutoring significantly increased school enrollment, while its effects on regular attendance and academic progression were imprecisely estimated. The information intervention generated limited evidence of impacts, with no statistically significant effects on the primary outcome or academic progression and only marginal evidence of an increase in any school attendance. Financial and academic support can help adolescents who left school early re-enroll, but larger studies are needed to identify which interventions most effectively sustain regular attendance.
abstract_zh: 尽管低收入和中等收入国家的小学入学率取得了显著进步，但中学完成率仍然较低。我们在布基纳法索进行了一项随机对照试验，评估旨在减少初中辍学的三项干预措施的有效性：（一）关于教育经济与健康回报的信息提供，（二）个性化辅导，以及（三）有条件现金激励。现金干预显著提高了学校注册率、任何形式的出勤率及规律出勤率，并减少了总缺课天数。辅导显著提升了学校注册率，但其对规律出勤和学业进展的影响估计不够精确。信息干预对主要结果或学业进展未显示出统计学显著影响，仅在增加任何形式的出勤方面有边际证据。财政和学业支持有助于早期辍学的青少年重新入学，但需更大规模的研究来确定哪些干预措施能最有效地维持规律出勤。
title: Reducing early secondary school leaving: experimental evidence on information, tutoring, and incentives from Burkina Faso
title_zh: 减少初中辍学：来自布基纳法索关于信息、辅导与激励的实验证据

abstract: Despite international consensus and actions, child labour remains prevalent and a global agenda. This paper uniquely examines the dynamic impact of parental death on child labour using rich longitudinal data from Ethiopia, while acknowledging limitations for making full causal interpretation. The empirical analysis, based on a conditional staggered difference-in-difference estimator, reveals a statistically significant impact of parental death on child labour. I specifically documented four key results. First, the cumulative effect of parental death outweighs the immediate effect. Second, the findings suggest a relatively higher impact of parental death around the age of 12 than earlier or later ages. Third, parental loss appears to push children toward unpaid household services rather than economic activities. Finally, maternal death has a stronger association with child labour than paternal death. These findings highlight the need for context-specific policy interventions and long-term support initiatives to mitigate the negative consequences of orphanhood on child development. Future research should explore multi-country analyses to provide a more comprehensive understanding and enable broader generalization of the impact of parental death on child labour.
abstract_zh: 尽管国际社会已达成共识并采取行动，童工现象依然普遍存在，成为全球性议题。本文利用埃塞俄比亚丰富的纵向数据，独辟蹊径地考察了父母死亡对童工的动态影响，同时承认在做出完整因果解释方面存在局限性。基于条件交错双重差分估计量的实证分析显示，父母死亡对童工具有统计上显著的影响。我具体记录了四项关键结果。首先，父母死亡的累积效应超过了即时效应。其次，研究结果表明，父母死亡在儿童约12岁时的相对影响高于更早或更晚年龄段。第三，父母丧失似乎促使儿童转向无酬家务服务而非经济活动。最后，母亲死亡与童工的关联强于父亲死亡。这些发现凸显了采取针对具体情境的政策干预和长期支持措施的必要性，以减轻孤儿状态对儿童发展的负面影响。未来研究应探索跨国分析，以提供更全面的理解，并促进对父母死亡影响童工这一问题的更广泛概括。
title: The dynamic impact of parental death on child labour: panel data evidence from Ethiopia
title_zh: 父母死亡对童工问题的动态影响：来自埃塞俄比亚的面板数据证据

abstract: When do AI platforms retain too much or too little user data? Users disclose proprietary context to obtain useful generative-AI output, but retention of that context creates exposure and may improve future systems. We formalize this user-side analogue of Arrow’s information paradox. The disclosure cap separates two regimes. Outside the capped region, behavioral adjustment is strong enough for equilibrium harm to fall with retention, so the planner’s optimum is a boundary choice. Within the capped region, the ratio of benefit appropriability to harm internalization governs platform retention: the platform under-retains when the ratio is below one and over-retains when it is above one. When retained inputs also raise AI quality, retention and disclosure become complements once quality feedback is sufficiently strong. Retention regulation corrects the platform’s choice; an interior disclosure choice generally requires an additional disclosure-side instrument to implement the joint first best.
abstract_zh: AI平台何时会保留过多或过少的用户数据？用户披露专有上下文以获取有用的生成式AI输出，但保留这些上下文会带来风险，并可能改进未来系统。我们形式化了这一用户侧的阿罗信息悖论类比。披露上限区分了两种情形。在受限区域之外，行为调整足够强，使得均衡损害随保留量增加而下降，因此规划者的最优选择是边界解。在受限区域之内，收益可占有性与损害内部化之比决定平台的保留行为：当该比率低于1时，平台保留不足；高于1时，则保留过度。当保留的输入同时提升AI质量时，一旦质量反馈足够强，保留与披露便成为互补关系。保留监管纠正了平台的选择；而内部披露选择通常需要额外的披露侧工具才能实现联合最优。
title: The reverse information paradox: When AI platforms retain too much or too little data
title_zh: 反向信息悖论：当AI平台保留过多或过少数据时

abstract: This paper studies how improvements in local accessibility influence cities’ distributions of nontradable amenities, housing costs and welfare. I build a model of local demand for these amenities, which depends on travel times and costs. Ridesharing’s entry shocks these times and costs. Three years after entry, amenities grow faster in areas which are driving-accessible and transit-inaccessible. In these locations, house prices and rents rise by 7% and 2% after three years, respectively. Taken together, the improvements in amenities and access outpace the rising housing costs. All residents benefit from ridesharing; yet, owners gain 24% more than renters on average, as they capture equity gains from rising house prices while renters face higher housing costs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了本地可达性的改善如何影响城市的非贸易性便利设施分布、住房成本与福利。我构建了一个对这些便利设施的本地需求模型，该需求取决于出行时间与成本。拼车服务的进入冲击了这些时间与成本。进入三年后，在驾车可达且公共交通不可达的区域，便利设施增长更快。在这些地点，三年后房价与租金分别上涨了7%和2%。综合来看，便利设施与可达性的改善超过了住房成本的上升。所有居民均从拼车服务中受益；然而，业主平均比租户多获益24%，因为他们从房价上涨中获得了资产增值收益，而租户则面临更高的住房成本。
title: Ridesharing and the redistribution of economic activity
title_zh: 共享出行与经济活动的再分配

abstract: This paper compares causal forests with varying-coefficient penalized spline estimators for heterogeneous treatment effects. We conduct simulations with randomized treatment assignment that vary heterogeneity, predictor dimension, and discrete nuisance structure. Performance is measured by out-of-sample mean squared error. Forests perform best in Wager–Athey designs with sharp treatment-effect transitions. Penalized splines tend to dominate when heterogeneity is smooth, when the baseline mean and treatment effect differ in structure, and in mixed designs with continuous, binary, and group-level covariates. As group cardinality rises, forest performance deteriorates, while mgcv random-effect smooths handle group structure effectively and remain easy to implement.
abstract_zh: 本文比较了因果森林与变系数惩罚样条估计器在异质性处理效应中的表现。我们通过随机化处理分配的模拟实验，变化异质性程度、预测变量维度及离散干扰结构。性能以样本外均方误差衡量。在Wager–Athey设计中，处理效应转变陡峭时，森林方法表现最佳。当异质性平滑、基线均值与处理效应结构不同，以及混合设计包含连续、二元和组级协变量时，惩罚样条通常占优。随着组基数增大，森林性能下降，而mgcv随机效应平滑能有效处理组结构，且易于实施。
title: Causal forests versus penalized splines for heterogeneous treatment effects
title_zh: 异质性处理效应下因果森林与惩罚样条方法的比较

abstract: We propose a methodology to test for the null hypothesis that the alphas of a panel of asset returns are jointly equal to zero in a linear factor pricing model with observable and tradable factors — that is, the null of “zero alpha”. The test is based on equation-by- equation estimation, using a randomized version of the estimated alphas, which only requires rates of convergence. The distinct features of the proposed methodology are that it does not require the estimation of any covariance matrix, and that it allows for both N and T to pass to infinity, with the former possibly faster than the latter. Further, unlike extant approaches, the procedure can accommodate conditional heteroskedasticity, non-Gaussianity, and strong cross-sectional dependence in the error terms. We also propose a derandomized decision rule to choose in favor or against the correct specification of a linear factor pricing model. Monte Carlo simulations show that the test has satisfactory properties and it compares favorably to several existing tests. The usefulness of the testing procedure is illustrated through an application of linear factor pricing models to the constituents of the S&P 500.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种检验方法，用于在线性因子定价模型中，针对可观测且可交易因子，检验一组资产收益的alpha是否联合为零的原假设——即“零alpha”原假设。该检验基于逐方程估计，采用估计alpha的随机化版本，仅需收敛速率即可。所提方法的显著特点在于，它无需估计任何协方差矩阵，并且允许N和T同时趋于无穷大，其中前者可能快于后者。此外，与现有方法不同，该程序能够适应误差项中的条件异方差性、非高斯性以及强横截面依赖性。我们还提出了一种去随机化决策规则，以选择支持或反对线性因子定价模型的正确设定。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该检验具有令人满意的性质，并且优于若干现有检验。通过将线性因子定价模型应用于标普500指数成分股，我们展示了该检验程序的实际效用。
title: A General Randomized Test for Alpha
title_zh: 一种通用的Alpha随机化检验

abstract: This paper investigates the long-term consequences of early-life exposure to the 1910–1911 Manchurian Plague, an epidemic with a near 100% case-fatality rate. Utilizing a 90-year horizon, we identify a distinct gender divergence in late-life outcomes. Early-life exposure generates persistent biological and socioeconomic scarring among women, while operating primarily through mortality selection for men. For women, early-life exposure results in significant deficits in late-life health, literacy, cognition, and household income. For men, childhood exposure significantly increases mortality in their 80s, suggesting that surviving males represent a positively selected group. These findings demonstrate that even highly lethal epidemics can generate lasting human capital losses through the indirect scarring associated with early-life epidemic-related disruptions.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了早年暴露于1910-1911年东北鼠疫（一种病死率近乎100%的流行病）的长期后果。利用长达90年的追踪视野，我们识别出晚年结局中显著的性别差异。早年暴露对女性造成持续性的生物学与社会经济创伤，而对男性则主要通过死亡筛选机制发挥作用。对于女性而言，早年暴露导致晚年健康、识字能力、认知功能及家庭收入方面的显著缺损。对于男性，童年期暴露显著增加了其80多岁时的死亡率，表明存活下来的男性代表了一个正向选择群体。这些发现表明，即便是致死率极高的流行病，也能通过与早年疫情相关干扰相关的间接创伤，造成持久的人力资本损失。
title: The enduring health impact of early-life exposure to the 1910–1911 Manchurian Plague
title_zh: 1910-1911年东北鼠疫早期暴露对健康的长期影响

abstract: Artificial intelligence is advancing at the same time as the global economy is becoming more fragmented. AI innovation is concentrated in a small number of economies, while the gains from AI depend on technologies, intermediate inputs, data, investment, and know-how moving across borders. This column shows that fragmentation can therefore shape not only the size of the global gains from AI, but also who receives them. For economies not at the technological frontier, preserving diversified links may be a valuable form of economic optionality.
abstract_zh: 人工智能的发展与全球经济日益碎片化同步推进。人工智能创新集中于少数经济体，而其收益则依赖于技术、中间投入、数据、投资和专业知识在跨国界的流动。本专栏指出，碎片化因此不仅影响人工智能全球收益的规模，也决定其分配格局。对于处于技术前沿之外的经济体而言，保持多元化的联系可能是一种宝贵的经济选择权。
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Jingyuan Cui, Asmaa El-Ganainy, Yevgeniya Korniyenko, Elyad Shojaei, Li Zeng, Shihangyin Zhang
title: AI in a fragmenting world: Why ‘connector’ economies can still gain
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI：为何“连接型”经济体仍能获益

abstract: Generative AT tools can help students complete assignments faster and achieve better scores. But completing these tasks is not the goal; learning from them is. This column uses data on over 25,000 7th to 12th grade students in China to examine how self-directed use of generative AI affects their learning. Time spent on homework for students who used AI went down and homework scores went up, but their exam scores fell. While the initial effect is small, it grows as students become more proficient with AI tools and as more course material is learned after adoption, suggesting that existing short-duration studies may underestimate the long-run learning costs of using generative AI.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能工具能帮助学生更快完成作业并取得更高分数。然而，完成这些任务并非目的，从中学习才是关键。本文基于中国超过25,000名7至12年级学生的数据，考察了自主使用生成式人工智能对其学习的影响。使用人工智能的学生在作业上花费的时间减少，作业成绩有所提升，但他们的考试成绩却出现下降。尽管初始影响较小，但随着学生对人工智能工具熟练度的提高以及采用后学习更多课程材料，这一影响逐渐增大，这表明现有短期研究可能低估了使用生成式人工智能的长期学习成本。
authors: David Strömberg, Victor Lei, Yanhui Wu
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The generative AI learning penalty in secondary school
title_zh: 中学阶段生成式人工智能学习的不利影响

abstract: This article introduces an iterative distributed computing (IDC) estimator for the multinomial logistic regression model with large choice sets. The IDC estimator reformulates the estimation problem as a sequence of structured, low-dimensional subproblems that can be solved efficiently and in parallel. We establish that, when initialized with a consistent estimator, the IDC estimator is asymptotically equivalent to the maximum likelihood estimator and achieves asymptotic efficiency under a weak dominance condition. We further develop a parametric bootstrap procedure for inference based on the IDC estimator and prove its consistency. Extensive simulation studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods and highlight the computational efficiency of the IDC estimator.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于大选择集多项逻辑回归模型的迭代分布式计算（IDC）估计量。IDC估计量将估计问题重构为一系列结构化、低维的子问题，这些子问题可高效并行求解。我们证明，在初始化为一致估计量的条件下，IDC估计量与最大似然估计量渐近等价，并在弱支配条件下实现渐近有效性。我们进一步开发了一种基于IDC估计量的参数自助法推断程序，并证明了其一致性。广泛的模拟研究验证了所提方法的有效性，并凸显了IDC估计量的计算效率。
title: Iterative distributed multinomial regression
title_zh: 迭代式分布式多项回归
